operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to raise a pre-seed round.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Let's review the fundraising strategy and make sure the current plan reflects what you've learned from the business so far.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Earlier, I planned to raise a pre-seed round.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives us a useful baseline for comparing the earlier financing approach with the one you are using now.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I now plan to raise a seed round.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: The shift in round size should be reflected consistently across your investor materials, outreach sequence, and internal planning.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The change followed the pilot traction.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That rationale can help investors understand why the financing plan changed rather than viewing the change as arbitrary.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The round plan is in the fundraising memo.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Use the memo as the source of truth when aligning the pitch materials and conversations with prospective investors.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want the financing narrative to stay grounded in the evidence rather than becoming overly polished.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A concise evidence-based narrative will make the updated round strategy easier to evaluate and execute.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Let's use the memo to guide the next fundraising work session.
